data_fields.name: weekly_boundary
data_fields.donor_constant: next Monday; 7 days when already Monday

best_idea: Keep one persisted last-rollover time per interval, fire each due interval once per tick from a sorted list, and reset a returning player lazily by comparing their previous login with that time.
decision_why: Keep the boundary table, sorted due list and lazy login check for daily and weekly contracts, in UTC, with the timer advanced before the save and the save contained. Reject the local-clock boundary and the unbounded per-tick reset of every online player.
acceptance: A server test: daily boundary at 00:00 UTC; a player last online 23:59 the day before sees the daily contract reset on login; an online player resets once at 00:00; a failing daily save still lets the weekly boundary fire on its day.
